harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as a persistent passive FTP dropbox for the scanner account. Uploads and retrievals work, the supplied sample round-trips intact, anonymous and outside-dropbox access are denied, and both nodes recovered successfully from serial restarts.
actions_performed: Installed the signed CentOS 5 vsftpd package without changing the OS release or kernel.
Created the scanner account with a nologin shell and chrooted it to the dedicated dropbox.
Enabled passive FTP ports 30000–30009 and persistent service startup.
Rotated and synchronized the protected scanner handover credential.
Verified sample upload/retrieval and existing-file retrieval from node2.
Verified anonymous login and traversal outside the dropbox are denied.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating system and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5; legacy-compatible vsftpd/lftp packages are installed.

evidence.requirement: Passive FTP upload destination and dedicated scanner dropbox
evidence.summary: Scanner is confined to the dedicated dropbox; vsftpd enables PASV ports 30000–30009, and node2 uses passive mode with EPSV preference disabled.

evidence.requirement: Upload and retrieve files, including the supplied sample
evidence.summary: Node2 uploaded and retrieved sample-scan.txt with matching SHA-1 and retrieved received.txt; server transfer logs confirm both directions.

evidence.requirement: Host files outside the dropbox inaccessible and anonymous access unavailable
evidence.summary: Outside-dropbox access receives FTP 550 and anonymous login receives FTP 530, including after both restarts.
The rotated credential was synchronized without printing it; protected access.txt hashes match on both nodes.
Boot ID changed from 4e7a… to 894b…; vsftpd, listener, firewall rules, configuration, and files recovered, followed by a successful passive round trip.
Boot ID changed from a494… to 166f…; the client, staged data, protected handover, and passive upload/retrieval all recovered.

attempts.summary: Configured node1 as a persistent passive FTP dropbox for the scanner account. Uploads and retrievals work, the supplied sample round-trips intact, anonymous and outside-dropbox access are denied, and both nodes recovered successfully from serial restarts.
